attrs.evidence: χ(K₄) = 4 > 3, so the union has no model. Each site is a perfect matching and trivially satisfiable. Each of the 7 simple cycles is a 3- or 4-cycle of disequalities, and every cycle of ≠ is 2- or 3-colourable. All three facts are computed, not asserted.
attrs.prior_art: The colouring reduction is standard; Erdős 1959 (high girth, high chromatic number) generalizes the construction to arbitrarily large girth.
attrs.statement: At |D| = 3 over {=, ≠}, a fidelity failure need not have any individually unsatisfiable cycle: K₄ with all-≠ edges split into three perfect matchings has every site satisfiable, every simple cycle satisfiable, and no 3-colouring.
attrs.supersedes: The record FED-Q2-D3, which stated the negative proposition 'no cycle-local predicate can characterize fidelity failure' and then marked it REFUTED while citing evidence FOR it. The polarity was backwards and 'cycle-local' was never defined. Split into this witness and FED-Q2-D3-LOCALITY.
